ruleset.name: AI Coding Java P3C
ruleset.description:
Alibaba P3C PMD baseline for AI-assisted Java development.
The upstream P3C PMD implementation was built against an older PMD/JDK toolchain. Validate compatibility with the JDK syntax used by the consuming project before treating this as a mandatory local check.
Repository architecture and modern Java/Spring rules take priority over obsolete architectural conventions. In particular, ServiceOrDaoClassShouldEndWithImplRule is intentionally excluded: a project should not create interface/Impl pairs only to satisfy a historical naming convention.
